svg.title: Which angle brackets declare and which fill in
svg.desc: Five lines of Rust. Circled: the brackets after Pair in struct Pair<T>, after first in fn first<T>, after impl in impl<T> Pair<T>, and the outer brackets after impl in the Plus line, because each is on something being created. Underlined: Pair<T> in the function and in the impl, Pair<i32>, Iterator<Item = i32> and Plus<I>, because each refers to something that already exists. impl Pair<i32> has no circle: it creates an impl but declares no new name.
